title: API Design Principles
description: Learn core principles for designing secure, maintainable APIs.

data.text:
**API Design Principles**

Good API design reduces attack surface and makes security easier to enforce consistently.

items: Use nouns, not verbs, for resource paths
Version your API to manage breaking changes
Fail securely: default to denying access

data.title: Good vs Bad Endpoint Design
data.content:
GET /api/users/123              (good)
GET /api/getUser?id=123          (bad - exposes intent)
POST /api/users                  (good)
POST /api/createUser             (bad - verbose, inconsistent)

data.title: Key Takeaways
data.takeaway: Secure APIs start with clean, consistent design decisions.
